baseline: 0.36.1 previously published frozen keys at historical cutoff; must match 100 ranks in each comparison.
data: Seven held-out Beijing dates, 2025-03-15 to 21 with three English GKG snapshots per date. Development case 2026-11-15 has two English GKG snapshots. No mixed-feed evaluation.
reference: Fixed 37 purposively chosen localized or broader public issues from prior code's pools, incl. sampled outside at the 100-seat cutoff. Coverage if any predeclared headline key is selected or attached, checked separately for lead-only. No estimation of the unknown population.
blinded_headline_review: After variants freeze, sample up to 8 new-only and 8 old-only leads per March date and 12 per group for November using seed news2douyin-v037-blind1 + date + key SHA-256, shuffle all using separate salted hash. Codex reads in random order, without variant, scores or prior ranks; assign clear material update, low priority, or uncertain. Clear = specific reported realized act, official adopted/announced concrete change, outcome, directly observed impact or attributed substantive update; exclude generic commentary, lifestyle promotion, rumors, retrospective and routine talk about prospects. This is judgement of whether a headline merits investigation, not independent factual verification or human panel.
merge_review: Audit every actual merged pair using retained titles and source links. Report same action, protected different phase/detail, false, or insufficient. If uncertain, preserve that uncertainty. Record known cases missed by conservative rules.
primary_metrics: Per arm: overlap with old seats, entrants/displaced; distinguish captured story via attached material from eligible candidates that moved out. Headline review OOS, diagnostics, duplicates, entrants. The single development day is reported separately. No default switch based solely on title judgements.
